meta: A video ad: a famous businessman explains how to invest for 30% a month. The face is right, the voice is right, but he never said it. Scammers take a real interview and use AI to change the lips and voice.

muc.title: A celebrity inviting you to invest?
muc.text: Mark is scrolling and sees a video ad: a famous businessman explains how to invest for 30% profit a month. The face is right, the voice is right. But that person never said this.

muc.title: Pieced together from old videos
muc.text: Scammers take a real interview video, use AI to change the lip movements and dub in a cloned voice, and turn it into a completely fake invitation.

muc.title: High returns, guaranteed, urgent
muc.text: Common signs: high returns that are "guaranteed", only a few spots left, and an invitation to a private chat group for "guidance".

muc.title: Lip movements and the page
muc.text: Look closely: the lips don't match the sound, and the page running the ad is usually new, not that person's official page.

muc.title: Look on the official page
muc.text: Check it: go to that person's official page, or read trusted news. A real invitation never lives only in some strange ad.

muc.title: Help others
muc.text: When you see a fake ad, report it. You might save an older person from being scammed.

muc.title: Remember three words
muc.text: Remember that high returns, guarantees and urgency are three familiar signs of a scam, then share this with your family.
